zh-CN.name: 功能展示型
zh-CN.description: 工作用页面标签：按用户目标分组介绍产品功能，用场景、实例和清楚的层级支持比较。它并不是把所有功能堆成等权重的卡片墙。
use_when: 产品有多组能力，用户需要选择适合自己的场景。
功能之间有明确分组和差异。
avoid_when: 不要把路线图功能描述为已可使用。
全部等权展示会增加寻找关键能力的负担。
zh-CN.prompt_template: 按用户任务分组介绍功能，先展示核心能力，再补充扩展能力；每组附一个具体使用例子与可验证状态；明确已支持、试验和计划中的功能，保留快速进入相关体验的入口。

en.name: Feature-Rich Showcase
en.description: A working page label for showcasing capabilities in groups tied to user goals, with scenarios, examples and hierarchy. It is not an instruction to give every feature equal prominence.
use_when: Users need to select among several capability groups.
Features have meaningful categories and differences.
avoid_when: Do not present roadmap items as currently available.
Equal emphasis on every feature makes priority capabilities harder to find.
en.prompt_template: Group capabilities by user task, lead with the core ones and then cover extensions. Provide a concrete example and verifiable availability for each group. Distinguish supported, experimental and planned features, and offer a direct route to relevant experiences.
